release_notes: Live Check now has its own settings menu with per-app triggers, plus two new hotkeys: Cmd+Shift+L turns suggestions on or off, and Cmd+Shift+Return applies everything on screen. Proposed Changes reads like 2.0.0 again, so only the edited words are highlighted and the pinpoint fixes stand out. Mail and Pages no longer beep in the background, applies keep working when you switch apps, every provider defaults to its current model (DeepSeek deepseek-flash, Gemini 3.8 Flash, GPT-5.5, Claude Sonnet 5, Grok 4.6, Groq GPT-OSS 120B), and the settings window is cleaner and faster.
